com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface IElementSelector

  • All Known Subinterfaces:
    IAbstractComponentPortSelector, ICommunicationElementSelector, IComponentPortSelector, IComponentTypeSelector, IEventSelector, IExecutableEntitySelector, IOriginComponentPortSelector, IPortInterfaceSelector, ISignalInstanceSelector, ISourceComponentPortSelector, ITargetComponentPortSelector

    @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface IElementSelector
    The IElementSelector API allows the definition of base predicates for several other selector APIs.

    Per default the predicates are combined via logical AND. To realize other combinations, use the 'or','not' and 'and' predicates.
